# NBC News

> NBC News provides breaking news, in-depth reporting, and shopping guides across politics, business, health, and consumer topics.

NBC News covers major news stories and events while also offering curated shopping guides through NBC Select, featuring deals on technology, home goods, and consumer products from major retailers like Amazon.

## Shopping & Deals

- [Amazon's Big Spring Sale Starts in 7 Days: These 37+ Early Deals Are Live](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/amazon-big-spring-sale-early-deals-2026-rcna263339): Early deals guide for Amazon's Big Spring Sale covering tech, home, and beauty discounts for Prime members.
